name: Griffonia
headline: Griffonia
description: Griffonia seed extract is a source of the amino acid that precedes serotonin. With vitamins B6 and B12 it supports endorphin synthesis in the brain, helps steady mood, reduces feelings of anxiety and makes falling asleep easier.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule a day with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Griffonia seed extract, vitamins B6 and B12, excipients.
